architecture:
PatchTransformer(
  (patch_embed): Linear(in_features=16, out_features=64, bias=True)
  (embed_drop): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
  (encoder): TransformerEncoder(
    (layers): ModuleList(
      (0-5): 6 x TransformerEncoderLayer(
        (self_attn): MultiheadAttention(
          (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
        )
        (linear1): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=160, bias=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
        (linear2): Linear(in_features=160, out_features=64, bias=True)
        (norm1): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (norm2): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout1): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
        (dropout2): Dropout(p=0.1, inplace=False)
      )
    )
  )
  (norm): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (head): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=10, bias=True)
)

training_config.train_transform:
Compose(
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-10.0, 10.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomCrop(size=(28, 28), padding=2)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.2862528489520806,), std=(0.3531738779381928,))
)
